purpose: Apply the Paper 3 within-season fixed-node aliasing metric, frozen before this source was introduced, to an independent 2024 SAR huddle dataset spanning six emperor-penguin colonies.

source.scope: Winter 2024 Umbra SAR observations at Atka Bay, Coulman Island, Cape Roget, Cape Washington, Franklin Island, and Cape Crozier.

relationship_to_primary_paper3.role: independent within-season validation while the Macdonald et al. 2017-2024 PDC archive is temporarily unavailable
relationship_to_primary_paper3.rule: No radius, centroid rule, or false-absence definition is changed after inspecting this SAR source.

standardization.obs_date: UTC acquisition date parsed from the leading YYYY-MM-DD portion of source image name
standardization.group_location: xcoord/ycoord WGS84 centroid for each manually delineated huddle
standardization.multiple_groups: Every huddle centroid on a date is retained as one mapped group.
standardization.anchor: Earliest date with one or more finite detected huddle centroids for each colony.
standardization.false_absence: On a later observation date, the fixed node is absent at radius r only if every mapped huddle centroid is farther than r from the frozen anchor centroid.

estimands.primary: Within-season false-absence fraction at 0.5, 1, 2, 5 and 10 km.
secondary: q50/q90/q95 of minimum huddle distance from the seasonal anchor on post-anchor dates
number of mapped dates and huddles per colony

boundaries: This source covers one winter season and cannot estimate interannual false turnover.
Named colony identity is supplied by the source and does not imply demographic closure.
Huddle movement is not individual dispersal.
No abundance, breeding success, sea-ice, or environmental predictor enters the validation.
The Macdonald 2017-2024 primary route remains locked until its public PDC files are reproducibly available.
